findings.problem: Panel can pass a focus-visible state without proving that focused components remain visible around sticky or persistent author-created content.

evidence.claim: The previous required-state list contained focus_visible but no focus-obstruction state.

findings.change: Require and validate a distinct WCAG 2.4.11 focus_not_obscured result with a rendered keyboard-test procedure.

personaImpact.priority: help - keyboard users can track their current interaction point
personaImpact.secondary: help - teams receive a concrete AA release check

findings.acceptanceCheck: A SHIPPABLE run without focus_not_obscured pass or justified n/a fails validation.
